source.title: On the stretch curvature of a Finsler space and certain open problems

trace.notes: Normalized https://zbmath.org/1385078 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1385078. Local shell fetches of https://zbmath.org/1385078 and https://api.zbmath.org/document/1385078 failed with DNS resolution errors in the restricted CLI environment, and the browser/page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record body for the exact URL.

Local workflow resolver metadata identified zbMATH id 1385078 as Makoto Matsumoto, "On the stretch curvature of a Finsler space and certain open problems," year 1997. A visible zbMATH author-profile search result also matched the exact title and Zbl 0967.53017. These metadata records were used only to identify the exact work, not as extraction evidence.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery searches for the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus Matsumoto, Zbl 0967.53017, and the journal citation J. Nat. Acad. Math. India 11 (1997), 22-32. Inspected visible candidates including Springer, OUCI, DergiPark, ScienceDirect, a University of Debrecen thesis bibliography, and related Finsler-geometry PDFs. These candidates were rejected because they were later citing papers, bibliographic references, metadata/index pages, or different works, and none provided a readable PDF or full HTML source for the same 1997 article containing the problem statements.
